parallels.note: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
translations.bsb: David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” And the large crowd listened to Him with delight.
translations.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
translations.asv: David himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
